name: Palatino Arms Shadow Gild
description: Elegant design meets innovation with the Palatino armor from Quirinus Tech. This armor set masterfully mixes reinforced plating with patented new materials that are light-weight and flexible, yet rated to withstand heavy damage allowing the wearer to be fashionable, light on their feet, and able to withstand serious firepower. The Shadow Gild variant is dark gray and features stylish gold highlights.
